ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - TestRunner (Dev)
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
RimSynapse - TestRunner (Development Only)
An automated test harness for the RimSynapse mod suite. This mod is intended for development and CI use only — it is not a gameplay mod and should not be enabled for normal play.
When RimWorld is launched WITHOUT the -synapse-test command line argument, this mod does nothing at all: it registers no tools, patches nothing, and has no runtime cost beyond loading an idle GameComponent.
When launched WITH -synapse-test, it waits for the game to finish loading, runs its test cases against the RimSynapse agent tool registry, writes results to the log in the form:
[SYNAPSE-TEST] PASS <case> | <detail> [SYNAPSE-TEST] FAIL <case> | <reason> [SYNAPSE-TEST] SUMMARY passed=N failed=M skipped=K
and then shuts the game down so an automated runner sees a clean exit.
Results are consumed by the RimSynapse harness (readlog.ps1 / the rimsynapse-mcp read_player_log and run_tests tools).
It loads last so that every other RimSynapse mod has registered its tools before the tests execute.
